title: PRD-19 synthetic risk input syntax

cargoDescription.description: required; 1–1000 NFC characters; no embedded files. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: CARGO_DESCRIPTION_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

commodityCode.description: required; contract-mapped cargo category <= 80. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: COMMODITY_UNMAPPED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

insuredValue.description: required; positive; value/currency/valuation basis explicit. Sensitivity: financial. Error: CARGO_VALUE_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

originCode.description: required; approved location code <= 80. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: ROUTE_LOCATION_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

destinationCode.description: required; approved location code <= 80. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: ROUTE_LOCATION_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

transportMode.description: required; one or multiple legs explicitly modeled. Sensitivity: internal. Error: TRANSPORT_MODE_UNAVAILABLE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

shipmentStart.description: required; route-local effective semantics. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: SHIPMENT_DATE_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

transportEvidenceRef.description: conditional; invoice/packing/transport document refs. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: TRANSPORT_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

description: Strict syntax baseline. Conditional predicates, cross-field dates/sums/relationships and actual carrier eligibility require the versioned application validator; passing this schema is not underwriting acceptance.
